skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze various aspects of economic activities and development processes.
Select and apply appropriate statistical analysis methods for specific practical issues.
Design plans and organize surveys for data collection, summarization, and presentation.
Collect and process data using statistical tools and software.
Write comprehensive reports with logical structure and clear conclusions.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve problems effectively.
Communicate effectively with stakeholders in professional settings.
Demonstrate self-directed learning and continuous improvement in professional skills.
Understand ethical responsibilities and social responsibilities in professional contexts.
